modern: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if you were moving along with them; and constantly consider the changes of the elements into one another, for such thoughts wash away the filth of life on earth.
original: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if thou wert going along with them; and constantly consider the changes of the elements into one another, for such thoughts purge away the filth of the terrene life.
notification: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if you were moving along with them…
notification_original: Look round at the courses of the stars, as if thou wert going along with them…

explained.summary: Look up at the stars and imagine moving along with them in their courses, and think often about how the elements turn into one another. Marcus says such thoughts wash away the grime of everyday life. It’s a deliberate change of perspective, from the petty and local to the vast and orderly.
explained.today: Ten minutes outside on a clear night, or reading about how far away the nearest galaxy is, can make the morning’s argument over the washing-up feel as small as it really is.
